title: Close-area benchmark matrix: 21 planners x 8 arena families x 2 range-sensor presets, with replays in the world JSON format
summary: Runs every close-area planner in the hub through the shared close-area-arena on the same seeded layouts and scores them on truth: straight, freest_beam, APF with wall-follow escape, VFH+, A* + ESDF on the known map, A* + ESDF on a map built from range hits (with the area geofence as its map prior), Informed RRT* 5000 on the known map, A* with the corridor MPC follower, the unknown-map A* behind the F2 PX4-CBF safety filter, and (added later) DWA, DWA with 3 s of scan memory, Bug2, TangentBug and D* Lite on the unknown map, then Theta* and Lazy Theta* on the known and unknown map, MPPI goal-only and on the unknown-map A* path, and Hybrid A*. Families: random, u_trap, narrow_gap, office, warehouse, forest, maze, glass_office. Presets: ideal 72-ray fan and a Crazyflie Multi-ranger preset (4 cone beams, 3 m, glass invisible). 20 layouts per cell, seed 0, 120 s limit on maze and warehouse. Writes one reached / collision table per preset with the best planner per family, and export_replays.py writes one replay per family x planner (layout 0) embedding the close-area-world/1 document, truth path, clearance per step and outcome, checked against the matrix rows. Planners are imported by path from their samples, unedited. Synthetic arena only.
verified: ran 2026-11-12 with CPython 3.12.10 + numpy 2.5.4 / scipy 1.18.1 / osqp 1.1.3 on an Apple M3 Max (16 cores, macOS arm64), in the sample venv, with the dropped-beam fix on (SKIP_DROPPED_BEAMS = True, docs/upstream-findings.md section 22): bench.py --layouts 20 --seed 0 --workers 10 --parity, all 21 rows in one run, 6,720 flights, wall 2963.7 s, parity with run.evaluate 10/10 for straight and astar_known. Against the previous matrix (built in three runs on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10): the 13 planners that build no map from the scan reproduced 4160/4160 runs exactly; the 6 unknown-map rows that dropout_fix.py also ran equal its status arm 1920/1920. export_replays.py --merge re-exported the 8 changed planners and the rows that had no replay: 168/168 replays match results/matrix_0.json, 168/168 world JSON round trips. bench.py --presets depth_cam_87 (5 map-free planners, 6 layouts) re-run the same day, wall 58.9 s; dwa_mem reproduced 48/48. Packs re-run with pack.py, 1 worker. test_smoke.py: 3 passed in the venv. Every number in README is from results/. Layouts, vehicle and sensors are simulated; planner sees the true pose; no SITL, no real drone.
shows: Which close-area planner reaches B in which room type (clutter, U trap, gap, office, warehouse, forest, maze, glass office) with a 72-ray sensor and with a 4-beam Crazyflie-like sensor, plus a replay per room type and planner
runtime: 2963.7 s for all 21 rows on 10 processes (6,720 flights); replays 329 s for 64 files on one process
key_result: [20 layouts per cell, seed 0, 21 planners](README.md#results-ran-2026-11-12-synthetic): prior-map planners (A* known, Informed RRT*, A* + MPC, Theta* and Lazy Theta* known) 100 % reached, 0 % collision in all 8 families on both presets. Without a map on the 72-ray sensor: D* Lite 55-100 %, unknown-map A* 50-100 %, MPPI on the A* path 55-100 %, 0 % collisions; with 4 Crazyflie beams unknown-map A* office 30 %, warehouse 5 % (55 % collision), glass_office 15 % (60 % collision); A* + F2 filter office 40 %, warehouse 30 %, maze 50 %. Reactive planners 0-40 % in office, warehouse and maze. Synthetic, true pose
